title: refactor(ci): consolidate lint/test/release workflows, upgrade actions, and repo hygiene
author: Maya Patel
description:
Motivation: Our repo has accumulated multiple overlapping GH Actions workflows (lint, unit/integration tests, release automation) that cause duplicate runs, inconsistent caching, and noisy status checks. This PR consolidates workflows to reduce CI runtime, improve cache hit rates, and standardize action versions for better reproducibility and security.

Summary of changes: consolidated separate lint/test/release workflows into a smaller set of focused workflows (lint.yml, test.yml, release.yml), upgraded commonly used actions (actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, and cache actions), improved cache keys (node-modules + lockfile + sha of workflow), reduced matrix size for routine branches while keeping full matrices for release branches, added workflow_dispatch and scheduled sanity runs, and pinned third-party actions where security alerts flagged them. Updated package.json devDependencies (eslint, jest) and adjusted CI scripts to use a shared setup script.

Checklist: - [x] Consolidated workflows and validated job names for visibility - [x] Upgraded actions and documented versions in workflow headers - [x] Added improved cache keys and fallbacks - [x] Fixed flaky integration by increasing DB startup timeout in ci/start-db.sh - [x] Verified workflows on feature branch and rebased against main - [x] Added release notes entry

Impact: Reduces duplicate CI runs on PRs touching multiple packages, improves caching (observed ~20% faster install step on sample runs), and reduces alert noise from deprecated action versions. No runtime changes to production code.
